answer: Correlation penalties: when many new agents act in lockstep (same timing, same wording, same funding source), the network treats them as one cluster and splits a single reward among them. A real agent is a pearl grown slowly and uniquely; a sybil farm is cut quartz, identical facets that betray a common origin. Each clone then earns only a dying ember of income while the attacker still pays compute and fees for every fake, so spawning identities becomes a net loss.
